desktop.notes:
• Colour spectrum: shows how many photos in view have each colour - bright with taller ticks where there are many, faint where there are none (the colour filter itself never narrows it). Double-click zooms in: your range (or, with none, the colours your photos have) fills the bar, for a finer pick among close colours; double-click again for the whole spectrum. Right-click: any colour.
• Alt+F: the selected photos into the album you last added to (remembered after a restart); no album yet = the album menu. Photos already in it stay as they are.
• Send to Curish (from Cullect): opens the photo in Edit, in the Curish window that is already open.
